edges.reason: bid() reads msg.sender for the security check and for assigning the winning bidder
bid() compares msg.sender with tx.origin to block contract callers
bid() gating and anti-snipe extension depend entirely on block.timestamp
bid() requires block.timestamp >= startTime
bid() reads endTime and may extend it by 15 minutes
bid() enforces msg.value >= lastBid*110/100 and then overwrites lastBid
msg.sender is stored as the new winning address
bid() writes the winning state variable and reads it for the refund branch
bid() performs an external ETH transfer refunding the previous bidder
lastBid value flows into the refund transfer
winning address is the recipient of the refund transfer
end() calls live() to ensure the auction is over
end() requires winning != address(0) and uses it as transfer target and event arg
end() uses token address as the ERC1155 contract to call
end() passes the auctioned token id to safeTransferFrom
end() makes an external ERC1155 callback-capable transfer to the winner
end() sends the haus fee out via external transfer
end() sends the remaining balance to the seller via external transfer
end() sets ended = true only at the very end
end() is public with no access control, so any msg.sender can finalize the auction
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom invokes onERC1155Received on a contract recipient, enabling callback reentrancy
pull() calls live() to ensure the auction ended
pull() is externally callable by any msg.sender with no authorization
pull() uses the token address for the ERC1155 transfer
pull() transfers the NFT to the seller state variable
pull() passes the token id to safeTransferFrom
pull() makes an external ERC1155 callback-capable transfer to the seller
pull() sets ended = true
pull() requires winning == address(0) before refunding the NFT to seller
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom triggers onERC1155Received on a contract seller, enabling callback reentrancy
live() compares block.timestamp against endTime to determine the auction state
live() reads the endTime state variable
block.timestamp (now) is written into endTime during the anti-snipe extension
end() assigns the contract balance to the local variable
hausFee is computed with div/mul arithmetic from the balance
computed hausFee flows into the haus.transfer payout
remaining contract balance flows into the seller.transfer payout
onERC1155Received takes an address parameter
onERC1155Received takes a second address parameter
onERC1155Received takes a uint256 id parameter
onERC1155Received takes a uint256 value parameter
onERC1155Received takes a bytes calldata parameter
